card.name: Ends of certain feed and drug names
card.fires_on: The word 'cake' after oil seed or protein-rich oil in livestock feed text, and the closing part of split words such as corticotropin, molasses, isosorbide and immune globulin.

modes.label: Feed cake
modes.description: The word cake after oil or oil seed in animal feeding descriptions.
modes.example: The amount of oil seed<< cake>> and poultry litter is 150

modes.label: Corticotropin ending
modes.description: The final piece of corticotropin in lists of drugs that interact with sodium-retaining agents.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: The closing piece of molasses, isosorbide or globulin when the word is split.
modes.example: Mol<<asses>> is fed in limited quantities

card.plain: It marks the last piece of a few specific words, such as oil seed cake, corticotropin and molasses.
